key.name: page-size
key.description: How many candidates each page of the candidate list shows.

key.name: switcher-hotkeys
key.description: The keys that open Rime's menu of options, as Rime names them, such as F4 or Control+grave. With none, the menu doesn't open.

key.name: ascii-toggle-key
key.description: The key that switches between Chinese and Latin input: either Shift (and Caps Lock, which also clears the composition), Caps Lock alone, either Control, or none.

key.name: inline-preedit
key.summary: Show the composition in the text
key.description: Show the text being composed where it will be inserted, rather than only in the candidate window.

key.name: preedit-style
key.description: What the text shows while composing: the input as typed, or a preview of the text it converts to.

key.name: cursor-type
key.description: Where the cursor sits in the composition: at the insertion point, or at the start of the text being converted.

key.name: traditional
key.description: Whether rime-ice's Pinyin and Double Pinyin engines start out typing traditional characters.

key.name: fuzzy-pinyin
key.description: Spellings rime-ice's Pinyin and Double Pinyin engines also accept for each other, each written as the sound typed, a hyphen and the sound it also stands for: zh-z lets z, c and s stand for zh, ch and sh.

key.name: full-shape
key.description: Whether the engine starts out typing full-width Latin letters, digits and punctuation.

key.name: ascii-punct
key.description: Whether the engine starts out typing Latin rather than Chinese punctuation.

key.name: simplification
key.description: Whether an engine with a switch to simplified characters starts out with it on.
